17-13-0303-C(1) Type 1 Narrative & Plans — 2300-2302 West Huron Street, Chicago, IL
Proposed Zoning: © _RM-6 Residential Multi-Unit District

Lot Area: 6,399.72 square feet (total)
(2300 W. Huron — 3,457.32 square feet)
(2302 W. Huron — 2,942.4 square feet)

Proposed Land Use: The Applicant is seeking a zoning change to divide the subject zoning lot
into two (2) independent zoning lots. The property at 2300 W. Huron will
remain improved with the existing three-story, ten (10) unit residential
building. The newly created zoning lot at 2302 W. Huron will be developed
with a new three-story, two (2) unit residential building with a detached
garage. The proposed three-story building will measure 37 ft.-10 inches in
height. The height and footprint of the existing three-story residential
building at 2300 W. Huron will remain without change. The subject
property is a Transit Served Location. The newly created zoning lot at 2302
W. Huron will be supported by two (2) garage parking spaces at the rear of
that lot. The existing ten (10) unit residential building at 2300 W. Huron
will not be supported by off-street parking. Pursuant to Sec. 17-13-0303-D
optional Administrative Adjustment and Variation and pursuant to Sec. 17-
13-1003-EE of the Chicago Zoning Ordinance, the Applicant is seeking to
decrease the off-street parking requirement for a Transit Served Location to
zero parking spaces for 2300 W. Huron, increase the off-street parking
requirement from 50% (1 parking space) to 100% (2 parking spaces) for
2302 W. Huron, reduce the front, rear, and west side setbacks for the
existing building at 2300 W. Huron, and all relief necessary, as allowed by
the Code, for the attached plans.

(A) _ The Project’s Floor Area Ratio:
a. 2300 W. Huron: 12,519.32 square feet (3.62 FAR) (existing)
b. 2302 W. Huron: 4,047 square feet (1.38 FAR) (proposed)

(B) The Project’s Density (Minimum Lot Area Per D.U.):
a. 2300 West Huron Street: 345.73 square feet per D.U.
(10 existing residential units)
b. 2302 West Huron Street: 1,471.2 square feet per D.U.
(2 proposed residential units)

(C) *The amount of off-street parking:
a. 2300 W. Huron: 0 parking spaces
b. 2302 W. Huron: 2 parking spaces

*The subject property is a designated Transit Served Location (Western Bus
Route), Pursuant to Sec. 17-13-1003-EE, the Applicant is seeking to decrease the
off-street parking requirement for a Transit Served Location to zero parking spaces
